catalog_scope.exact: distribution + top only (regenerate with the CLI)
catalog_scope.full: signatures with at least one player, player+class-skills or controlled member
catalog_scope.path: signatures with at least one player, player+class-skills or controlled member

caveat: a signature groups authored lifecycle inputs; it does not imply identical runtime behaviour (scripts, overlays and Retail may differ) nor executable support

granularities.full: every spell axis + multiset of effect tuples (kind, class, period, target)
granularities.id: prefix + sha256(canonical JSON of the signature)[:12]; stable across runs
granularities.path:
-- :data:`PATH_AXES` + aura-interrupt / dispellable booleans + the
      externally touched surface *names* (policy source folded) + the
      *set* of (kind, class, period, points) effect tuples (implicit target and multiplicity folded)
